title: Enroll
summary: ENROLL, verb transitive 1. To write in a roll or register; to insert a name or enter in a list or catalogue; as, men are enrolled for service. 2. To record; to insert in records; to leave in writing.

inlines.v: ENROLL, verb transitive 1. To write in a roll or register; to insert a name or enter in a list or catalogue; as, men are enrolled for service. 2. To record; to insert in records; to leave in writing. 3. To wrap; to involve.
